Live data relay — optional

aviationweather.gov blocks direct browser requests (no CORS headers), so a live board needs a tiny proxy you host. Paste its URL here and the board will fetch through it. Without a relay the board still lists your airports with one-tap links to the official pages, and the decoder above always works.

Stored only in this browser (suite.relay.url). The relay is called as RELAY?url=<encoded aviationweather URL> and must return aviationweather's METAR JSON.

Show a small Cloudflare Worker you can deploy free

Create a Worker at workers.cloudflare.com, paste this, deploy, and use its URL above (the repo ships a fuller template with a host allowlist at relay/worker.js):

export default {
  async fetch(req) {
    const target = new URL(req.url).searchParams.get("url") || "";
    const u = new URL(target);
    if (u.protocol !== "https:" || u.hostname !== "aviationweather.gov")
      return new Response("host not allowed", { status: 403 });
    const r = await fetch(u);
    return new Response(await r.text(), {
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json",
                 "access-control-allow-origin": "*" }
    });
  }
};

It only forwards public METAR text and adds the CORS header your browser needs. Keep the URL private-ish; anyone with it can read METARs through your Worker.

Heads-up for the published build: dist/airport.html carries a Content-Security-Policy that only allows hosts known at build time, so a relay fetch is blocked there. Use the repo's tools/airport.html source file, or add your relay host to this tool's manifest endpoints and rebuild.

Data: NOAA/NWS Aviation Weather Center (aviationweather.gov) · FAA status: nasstatus.faa.gov · Decoder runs on your machine.
